title: Objective 4 Manual enact count not triggering as much as expected.
symptom: User started Objective 4 and noticed the manual enact count stopped triggering after a few hours of using temp targets. They have 37 temp target events but only 7 recommendations in about a week.
cause: The objective wording is ambiguous, leading users to think temp targets count as manual enacts, but only open loop enacts count. Additionally, the user's AAPS was not sending all data to Nightscout, resulting in fewer recommendations.
fix: No code fix; clarification that only open loop enacts count. User may adjust the percentage in loop settings for more suggestions or manually set a 0 TBR to trigger a suggestion. The user resolved by understanding the objective and fixing data transmission.
evidence_quote: It's only Open Loop enacts that increase counter for manual enacts.
